messages:
Alex: FYI - customer 'Cobalt Financial' wants a POC for SSO + SCIM, must include RBAC mapping and domain controls.
Priya (SE): Can we confirm SAML 2.0 IdP metadata and SCIM v2 (delta) support? They asked for JIT provisioning too.
Maria: Also need a pricing estimate for Dedicated/reserved capacity for ~3M tokens/month and a Private deployment uplift. Any ballparks?
Sam: Ballpark for Dedicated reserved pool + baseline usage is ~\$15k/month; Private/VPC uplift TBD. I'll pull formal tiers.
Priya (SE): Security questionnaire highlights: org-level domain verification, IdP-initiated and SP-initiated SSO, SLO hooks, audit logs >=1yr, KMS integration, and SCIM provisioning controls.
Jenna: Legal blocker: they require EU-only data residency and DPIA. That pushes to Private (VPC/on-prem).
Alex: Ok — Private is possible. Need Legal + Infra alignment on contract and deployment timeline.
Priya (SE): Quick SAML/SP notes we should send them (short):
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.example/sp">
  <SPSSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://redwood.example/saml/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

Priya (SE): SCIM example (for their IdP team): `POST https://api.redwood.example/scim/v2/Users` with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. We support both full and delta sync, and group-to-role mappings.
Sam: For RBAC we map SCIM groups to Redwood roles; can demo a mapping YAML during POC. I can prepare a sample mapping file.
Maria: Timeline proposal: kickoff next Tue, 2-week technical POC, +1 week for domain verification and security sign-off. Customer asked for canary traffic test halfway.
Alex: Ops asks: get customer infra contact for IP allowlist + wildcard certs. @sec-team-bot can you create the security checklist for this POC?
sec-team-bot: Security checklist created: https://redwood.in/sec/q/1991002345 - items: KMS integration, audit log retention, pen test history, SCIM scoping, network allowlist. :white_check_mark:
Priya (SE): I'll compile SAML metadata, SCIM endpoint docs, and a short RBAC mapping template and send by EOD.
Jenna: Legal will start review; ask the customer to sign DPIA addendum if they require EU residency.
Maria: Pricing note: include Dedicated reservation + Private uplift + single-tenant support line items; I'll attach a breakdown to the POC doc.
Sam: I'll prepare demo credentials, a runbook for SCIM provisioning, and a small script to validate group sync: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" https://api.redwood.example/scim/v2/Groups`.
Alex: Great — reconvene Monday to finalize agenda and ship the kickoff invite. :thumbsup:
thread_text_preview: Cobalt Financial POC for SSO+SCIM: SAML metadata, SCIM delta, RBAC mapping, pricing for Dedicated+Private, legal DPIA / EU residency, security checklist, POC timeline
